_readme: Predefined inputs for Install-NeologikEnvironment.ps1. Copy this file to 'inputs.json' (auto-detected next to the script) or pass its path with -AnswerFile. Every value here pre-fills the matching prompt: press Enter to accept, or type to override. This file contains ONLY configuration inputs that end up in the exported config; runtime decisions (Terms acceptance, PowerShell/module install, re-auth, quota/permission warnings) are always asked interactively and are never read from here. Replace every REPLACE_ME / example value below before use. Remove any field to fall back to its built-in default (for default fields) or to be prompted with no pre-fill (for per-client fields).
organizationCode: REPLACE_ME — client 3-letter code, lowercase, e.g. abc
organizationName: REPLACE_ME — full company name, e.g. Contoso Ltd
fqdn: REPLACE_ME — bot's full hostname (FQDN), e.g. neologik.contoso.com

bots.agentName: REPLACE_ME — full agent name, e.g. Neologik
bots.shortName: REPLACE_ME — lowercase, max 4 chars, e.g. bot
